title: Fleet Overview
description: Every service's health, RED metrics, dependencies, limiter, pool and JVM. GENERATED by docker/lgtm/generate.py, do not edit: change the generator and rerun it.

panels.title: Alive
panels.description: UP: the service exported metrics in the last 30s. DOWN: seen in the last hour, silent for 30s. A service never seen in the last hour is not listed; ServiceDown still pages for it. Click a tile for its logs and traces.

panels.title: JVMs per service
panels.description: Metric identity: each JVM is its own series (instance = host:port:pid), so this counts the JVMs that exported under each service in the last 30s. A number below the replicas running means two JVMs share one series and every rate panel above is wrong.

panels.title: Firing and pending now
panels.description: Rules currently Pending or Firing. Empty is the healthy state. Every rule is on the Alerts dashboard with its input plotted.

panels.title: Requests: rate, errors, duration (actuator health polls excluded)
Request rate by service
panels.description: Requests per second each service answered. Click a series for that service's logs or traces over the same window.

panels.title: 5xx ratio by service
panels.description: Share of each service's answers that were 5xx. HighErrorRate fires above 5% for 2 minutes. Empty means no request was answered with 5xx.

targets.expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$interval])) / sum by (job) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$interval]))

panels.title: p95 latency by service
panels.description: 95th percentile answer time. The diamonds are exemplars: one real request each, click one to open its trace in Tempo.

panels.title: Requests by endpoint and status
panels.description: Per route template and status code, so a merchant id never becomes a series. The gateway's routes are its path patterns.

targets.expr: sum by (job, method, uri, status) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$interval]))

panels.title: p95 latency by endpoint
panels.description: Per route template, with exemplars linking to the trace of a real request. The 500 ms line is the latency SLO LatencySLOBurn watches.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, uri, le) (rate(http_server_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$service", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$interval])))

panels.title: Outbound calls by target and status
panels.description: HTTP calls a service makes: the gateway to ledger-svc and conversion-svc, conversion-svc to ledger-svc and the rate feed. client_name is the host called.

panels.title: Outbound p95 by target
panels.description: Time to the dependency's answer, with exemplars. The gateway's line includes the upstream service's own time.

panels.title: Ledger gRPC (conversion-svc to ledger-svc): calls, errors, breakers, dead letters
Calls by method and status
panels.description: Each attempt conversion-svc made to ledger-svc over gRPC, so a retried call shows once per attempt. Empty: conversion-svc made no gRPC call to the ledger in the window.

panels.title: Error ratio by method
panels.description: Share of attempts per method that ended in any status but OK (UNAVAILABLE and DEADLINE_EXCEEDED are retried). 0 is the healthy state; empty: no gRPC call in the window.

targets.expr: (sum by (rpc_method) (rate(grpc_client_milliseconds_count{job="conversion-svc", net_peer_name="ledger-svc", grpc_status_code!="OK"}[$interval])) or sum by (rpc_method) (rate(grpc_client_milliseconds_count{job="conversion-svc", net_peer_name="ledger-svc"}[$interval])) * 0) / sum by (rpc_method) (rate(grpc_client_milliseconds_count{job="conversion-svc", net_peer_name="ledger-svc"}[$interval]))

panels.title: Latency p95 and mean by method
panels.description: p95 from the grpc.client histogram buckets (shared observability config), with the mean (sum over count) beside it. Empty: no gRPC call in the window; a mean with no p95 means the JVM runs without the grpc.client buckets.

targets.expr: sum by (rpc_method) (rate(grpc_client_milliseconds_sum{job="conversion-svc", net_peer_name="ledger-svc"}[$interval])) / sum by (rpc_method) (rate(grpc_client_milliseconds_count{job="conversion-svc", net_peer_name="ledger-svc"}[$interval]))

panels.title: Circuit breakers
panels.description: Each ledger breaker's state, the worst across conversion-svc JVMs: CLOSED passes calls, OPEN refuses them for 10s, HALF_OPEN lets 3 through to test. Empty: no conversion-svc exported in 30s.

targets.expr: max by (name) (last_over_time(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state{job="conversion-svc", name=~"ledger.*", state="closed"}[30s]) * 0 or last_over_time(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state{job="conversion-svc", name=~"ledger.*", state="half_open"}[30s]) * 1 or last_over_time(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state{job="conversion-svc", name=~"ledger.*", state="open"}[30s]) * 2 or last_over_time(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state{job="conversion-svc", name=~"ledger.*", state="forced_open"}[30s]) * 3 or last_over_time(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state{job="conversion-svc", name=~"ledger.*", state="disabled"}[30s]) * 4 or last_over_time(resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state{job="conversion-svc", name=~"ledger.*", state="metrics_only"}[30s]) * 5)

panels.title: Dead letters
panels.description: Ledger calls conversion-svc gave up on, per op and reason, and dead letters Kafka did not take (not published), each counted over 5m including a series' first event. Empty is the healthy state: no dead letter in the window.

targets.expr: sum by (op, reason) (clamp_min(ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_total{job="conversion-svc"} - ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_total{job="conversion-svc"} offset 5m, 0) or (ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_total{job="conversion-svc"} unless ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_total{job="conversion-svc"} offset 5m))

sum by (op) (clamp_min(ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_publish_failed_total{job="conversion-svc"} - ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_publish_failed_total{job="conversion-svc"} offset 5m, 0) or (ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_publish_failed_total{job="conversion-svc"} unless ezeebit_conversion_ledger_deadletter_publish_failed_total{job="conversion-svc"} offset 5m))

panels.title: Limiter decisions by outcome
panels.description: Each merchant request's admission: allowed, limited (429), contention, unavailable (Redis did not answer: 503, fail closed) or refused_path. No merchant tag.

panels.title: Limiter decision p95 (Redis round trip)
panels.description: The bucket check against Redis, timed by the 'rate limit' span inside each gateway request. Exemplars open that request's trace.

panels.title: Redis reachable
panels.description: 1 when every gateway's PING to Redis answered within 250 ms on its last probe (min across gateways). 0 is RateLimiterStoreDown.

panels.title: Connections in use, idle and waiting
panels.description: Per service, each JVM's last value in 30s, so a restarted JVM's old series drops out. 'waiting' is threads blocked on the pool: DbPoolSaturated fires while it stays above 0. Only ledger-svc and conversion-svc have a database.

panels.title: Pool utilisation
panels.description: Connections in use as a share of the pool's maximum (10 by default).

panels.title: Connection acquire p95 and timeouts
panels.description: Time to get a connection from the pool, and connections that timed out (each one a failed request). Timeouts empty is the healthy state.

panels.title: Heap used and committed
panels.description: Heap in use per service against what the JVM has committed. The maximum is left out: on this laptop it is a quarter of RAM and flattens every line.

panels.title: GC pause time per second
panels.description: Seconds spent paused for garbage collection per second of wall time.

panels.title: Warnings and errors logged
panels.description: Log events at WARN and ERROR per minute. Click a series for the lines themselves.
